text:
alex: heads up i'm about to run staged rollout of routing.runtime.rebalance_safety tonight. initial cohort 8%. want a console 'preview + validate' flow before apply. cc @maya @ron
maya: please include expected quota impact and cost delta. product wants a one-click preflight that returns a small validation report.
alex: preview endpoint: /console/configs/runtime/rebalance_safety?preview=true. payload example: {
  "key":"routing.runtime.rebalance_safety",
  "value":0.08,
  "strategy":"staged",
  "stages":[{"cohort":"canary","pct":8}]
}
ron: telemetry: add trace->config mapping and a temp alert: p95 latency > 220ms for 10m. also token-cost breakdown per tenant.
sri: recommend dry_run=true support: simulate decisions, emit metrics, no weight changes. sample_rate=0.6 for canary. add dashboard panels: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, quota-usage, cost-per-token, config.rollout.latency.delta.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary redeploy scheduled (job y77). ETA ~9m.
ron: add auto-pause when alert fires, with TTL 30m and owner tags. we should also add an endpoint to pin fallback routing.
maya: UI ask: preflight report shows top affected tenants, estimated qps shift, cost delta, and a risk score (low/med/high). product likes that.
alex: backend contract: POST /api/configs/apply?dry_run=true -> return report with diffs and estimates. curl example: curl -X POST /api/configs/apply?dry_run=true -d @payload.json -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
sri: will add a playbook snippet to the console: how to pause, pin fallback, force rollback. sample rollback: curl -X POST /api/configs/apply -d '{"key":"routing.runtime.rebalance_safety","value":0.0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
alex: schedule: start 22:45 PT. stages 8% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 20m windows. i'll post updates in #eng-platform.
ron: also suggest adding a canary header for tracing and a small lookup page to map request-id -> config-version.
ops-bot: monitorbot: synthetic dry-run job started (job dry-11).
maya: i'll watch dashboards and be ready to hit rollback.
alex: thanks all, pushing preview now.
